assumptions: All weights, change scales, bands, gates and extrapolation limits are explicit engineering choices; they were not fitted or clinically validated.
The median pairwise slope over the last 14 UTC measurement days continues for seven future UTC dates, bounded by the configured slope and value limits.
The historical reference is the median of observed daily medians before the latest measurement day in that window; it is not a verified stable clinical baseline.
Symptoms available within 48 hours are held constant for the projection; their future course is not predicted.
Unknown sensor or symptom contributions span zero to their full weight. This is an input-completeness bound, not a confidence interval.
The score measures projected change from a personal historical reference, not absolute illness severity. A low score does not establish normal measurements or safety.
Separate source, device and context streams are never pooled. Stream selection uses fixed context priority, then recency and lexical identity, never the resulting score.
Historical source clocks can be assumed. Dates are an as-of scenario, not a live patient forecast. No treatment effect or event probability is supplied.
